diagnostics.message: The EventBridge target can become active before the Lambda permission is installed, so scheduled invocations may fail until `aws_lambda_permission.syncer` is available.
The EventBridge target can become active before the Lambda permission is installed, so scheduled invocations may fail until `aws_lambda_permission.scale_down` is available.
The EventBridge target can become active before the Lambda permission is installed, so scheduled invocations may fail until `aws_lambda_permission.pool` is available.
The GitHub App update can register the endpoint before the API Gateway default stage is created and deployed; it should wait for the stage to be ready.
The GitHub App update can register the endpoint before the API route exists, leaving the configured webhook endpoint unavailable; it should wait for the route.
The GitHub App update can enable webhook deliveries before API Gateway has permission to invoke the Lambda, causing deliveries to fail; it should wait for the Lambda permission.
